units.title: Quantum gravity in the interior = QFT on the boundary
units.summary: Maldacena stresses the better name is holography / gauge–gravity duality: a quantum gravity (often string) theory in a spacetime bulk equals a quantum field theory defined on the boundary of that spacetime.

units.title: Basics without supersymmetry first
units.summary: Part 1 aims at the basic idea without supersymmetry or integrability; later lectures add tools. Multiple concrete examples exist; many involve string theory as a UV completion of gravity.

units.title: Weakly coupled strings vs strongly coupled gauge theory
units.summary: In a regime of weakly coupled strings in the bulk (semiclassical gravity), the dual gauge theory is typically strongly coupled—computational leverage of the duality.

units.title: Operators and correlation functions
units.summary: Dictionary culture: boundary operators and their correlators match bulk fields / bulk computations (to be expanded in later parts); large-N / classical bulk limits appear as standard controls.
